nodes.label: Node ID format rule
nodes.rationale: IDs must use the full repo-relative path (every directory level, not just immediate parent) so semantic-extraction IDs match the AST extractor's scheme; otherwise same-named files in different directories collide and re-extracting an old immediate-parent-format project creates orphan ghost-duplicate nodes.

nodes.label: Confidence score rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete confidence values (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) are specified instead of a continuous range because production data showed models collapse continuous 0-1 guidance into a bimodal distribution (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+); a fixed rubric is easier for models to follow consistently.
